data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word βασιλεύς (basileus), meaning 'king' or 'master'. This name can be given to a child who is destined to become a leader, a builder, or a craftsman. In the Bible, King David and King Solomon are known as 'builders' of God's kingdom. The name Baseler carries the meaning “Master Builder” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Baseler usually hope their child will grow to embody master builder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
